traces: Evaluate residues 0..6: polynomial mod7 gives 1,3,0,6,0,3,1. Thus n=2 or4 mod7. 1000=7*142+6 so each residue 1..6 occurs143 times, total286. Can express each progression 2..996 and4..998 each143.
answer:
The value of \(n^2+n+1\) modulo \(7\) depends only on \(n\) modulo \(7\):

\[
\begin{array}{c|rrrrrrr}
n\bmod 7&0&1&2&3&4&5&6\\ \hline
(n^2+n+1)\bmod 7&1&3&0&6&0&3&1
\end{array}
\]

Thus, we need \(n\equiv 2\) or \(4\pmod 7\).

Since \(1000=7\cdot142+6\), there are \(142\) complete blocks of seven integers, each containing two solutions. The remaining six integers contain one of each required remainder, giving two more solutions.

Therefore, the count is
\[
2(142)+2=\boxed{286}.
\]
